item.title: Master's project: Reliability Estimation in Series Systems
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: I presented my master’s project in October 2023. It was titled ‘Reliability Estimation in Series Systems: Maximum Likelihood Techniques for Right-Censored and Masked Failure Data’.
item.content:encoded:
To complete my masters degree in statistics/mathematics at SIUe I presented my master’s project in October 2023. Their was also a paper associated with the project titled “Reliability Estimation in Series Systems: Maximum Likelihood Techniques for Right-Censored and Masked Failure Data”.

See the project here.
